Name: Kenneth's Sushi Ramen and Bento
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Sushi, Ramen and Bento[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Adds sushi, ramen and bento to Stardew Valley.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What is inside[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Hand rolls like Shrimp Tempura Hand Roll and more[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Nigiri like Ebi Shrimp Nigiri, Crispy Shrimp Tempura Nigiri, Salmon Roe Nigiri Boat, Maguro Tuna Maki Roll, Ikura Gunkan and more[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Maki rolls like Tuna Hosomaki, Cucumber Seaweed Maki, Salmon Avocado Roll, Rainbow Veggie Maki, Salmon Avocado Temaki Roll and more[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Ramen bowls like Shoyu Ramen Noodle Bowl and Miso Pork Ramen Bowl[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Bento boxes like Traditional Bento Box Lunch, Two Tier Bento Lunch Box, Shogun Bento Lunch Box, Colorful Sushi Bento Box and Deluxe Sushi Box Set[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Other plates like Sashimi Variety Platter Bowl, Mixed Donburi Bowl Platter and Panda Chopsticks Sushi Plate[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Items like Wooden Chopstick Pair Set - needed to buy the foods via trade[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- All food items have food buffs[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]The items are sold through my custom shop[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Japanese Restaurant[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Shop location can be changed in GMCM and defaults to Shop3.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]No recipes for now, items are sold directly in the shop. Recipes will be added in a future update.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Perfection Note[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod does not block perfection even without recipes.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Japanese Restaurant[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Generic Mod Config Menu recommended for changing shop location[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Full requirements list is shown in the Requirements tab above.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Install all required mods listed above[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Unzip this mod into your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Run the game with SMAPI[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with most content mods.[/b][/size]
